business: Nota (@NotaGetBot): a Telegram bot that collects receipts, invoices and handwritten delivery notes from work chats into the owner's Google Sheet and flags duplicates and arithmetic errors
by_segment: Villa management company or villa rental operator
Remote investor in villas or a build, living abroad
why_not: My admin already types the receipts into Excel every week. It's behind, sure, but it gets done, and I'm not paying a monthly fee and moving everything to Google Sheets to fix something that roughly works.

My bookkeeper already runs everything through Zoho and it works well enough. The missing documents are a staff discipline problem, and I'm not adding another tool and another login from overseas on the strength of a Telegram bot I've never heard of.

I might throw the 40 free documents at it out of curiosity, but I wouldn't pay. A brand-new bot from a team I've never heard of, sitting in my staff chats and my Google Drive, could vanish in six months, and I could put together something good enough with n8n and ChatGPT over a weekend.

I don't put an unknown bot in my staff chat or sign it into my Google account. It would read everything people write there, not only receipts. The missing papers at month end bother me, but not enough to hand that over to someone I don't know.

My bookkeeper already collects everything once a month and I almost never look at receipts myself, so this solves a problem I mostly handed off already. I might let it run on the free 40, but I doubt I'd start paying for it.

My rental shop doesn't have that many receipts. Staff send them to the group, I look at them, and my partner and I go through the month together. A duplicate means I talk to the person, and a bot can't do that for me. I'd try the 40 free ones out of curiosity, but I wouldn't pay $19 a month for something I can do in an evening with a spreadsheet.

I'd probably throw the free 40 at it to see if it can read my staff's handwritten nota, but after that $19 a month for something I can do in Excel on a Sunday is one more subscription I'd cancel. My expenses aren't big enough to need a bot watching them.

I'd probably throw my old chat in for the 40 free documents just to see, but $19 every month for something my Excel sheet and the bank screenshots already half do is hard for me to justify. My crews send maybe a few dozen receipts a week, so I'd blow past 100 and be looking at $45, and that's real money.

I'd burn the 40 free documents on my old chat archive just to see if it flags the re-photographed transfers, but I could wire up n8n plus ChatGPT to dump receipts into a Sheet in an afternoon. Unless the duplicate catching is clearly better than what I'd build, I'm not paying monthly for a receipt-to-table bot.

I'd burn the 40 free ones, sure, but my guys' nota from the supply shop are scribbled in Indonesian half the time and smudged with cement. If I'm checking every row by hand anyway, I'm not paying $45 a month for the privilege.
why_yes: I'm abroad half the year and only notice a problem on the build once money has already gone, so a sheet that fills itself and a Monday report I can send my partner is worth $19 to me without much thought. I'd run the free 40 on the old chat archive first, and if it catches one duplicate or a padded nota, I'm paying.

My admin is always weeks behind on the supply-shop nota and I lose track of what the guys actually spent on site. The free 40 docs costs me nothing to test on old chat history, and if it reads the handwritten nota properly, $45 a month is nothing next to one double-paid material run.

I already scroll the site chats at night trying to work out where the materials money went, so if it just sits in the group and fills a sheet without my foremen doing anything, $45 a month is nothing next to one duplicated cement receipt. I'd run the free 40 on my real chat history first and only pay if the sheet actually matches what I know was spent.

My admin is always a week behind on the receipt spreadsheet, and I'm reading the group chat at midnight trying to work out what got spent. If my guys just keep sending photos to the same chat and it lands in a sheet, $45 a month is nothing next to one double-paid supplier invoice.
